description: This file is a shell script for automating interactions with Perforce (p4) and Git, including tasks like starting a p4 daemon, initializing depot, creating shelved change lists, and unshelving changes. It contains function definitions, command sequences, and test cases to verify p4 and git-p4 workflows.

methods.name: last_shelved_change
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent shelved change ID from Perforce.

methods.name: shelve_one_file
methods.description: Creates a new shelved change list in Perforce with a specified file.

search-terms: shell script p4 and git integration
